packageRules.description: Minors, patches and the weekly lockfile refresh fast-forward the default branch once its checks pass; a failure opens a PR instead
A major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for a tick, or for tren update --latest
typescript-eslint needs the `typescript` JS API, which TS 7 lacks; drop once a typescript-eslint release supports TS 7.1 (typescript-eslint#12803)
